hook: Stop saying what you do. Start saying what changes because you exist.
direction: Rewrite exercise, mission-flavored: "We provide community programs" → "Families in our city find help and hope." "Full-service marketing" → "Your mission reaches the people it was meant for." Carousel: 3 before/after rewrites (church, nonprofit, Christian business).

facebook.text:
Stop saying what you do. Start saying what changes because you exist.

Most organizations describe their activity. The people they serve are looking for a result.

"We provide community programs" is about you. "Families in our city find help and hope" is about them.

"Full-service marketing agency" is about you. "Your mission reaches the people it was meant for" is about them.

That shift is the whole game. When you put the person you serve at the center of your message, they recognize themselves in it — and they respond.

Swipe through the carousel for three before-and-after rewrites: a church, a nonprofit, and a Christian business. Try it with your own language.

cover.title: Say What Changes

slides.title: Church
slides.body:
Before: "We offer Sunday services, small groups, and community outreach."

After: "People in this city find belonging, purpose, and a place to grow."

slides.title: Nonprofit

After: "Families in our city find help and hope when they need it most."

slides.title: Christian Business
slides.body:

After: "Your mission reaches the people it was meant for."
